tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Also blanket-rewrite Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors (leaf static class, no sub-namespace, no struct collision with the 's' guard).

failed_apis.why_tried: Original UWP MainPage.xaml.cs used Windows.UI.Colors.Green/Red for the status border brush; the bootstrap did not rewrite it.
failed_apis.root_cause: Windows.UI.Colors relocated to Microsoft.UI.Colors in WinUI 3, but the bootstrap only auto-rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml.
failed_apis.fix: Changed Windows.UI.Colors.* to Colors.* with 'using Microsoft.UI;' (agent turns 27-28); rebuild succeeded.

doc_errors.wrong: 'All Windows.UI.Xaml.* namespaces move to Microsoft.UI.Xaml.*:' — but the table also lists non-Xaml rows (Colors, Composition, Input, Text, Core) and does not say which the bootstrap actually auto-applies.
doc_errors.correct: Clarify that non-Xaml Windows.UI.* namespaces also relocate and that the bootstrap only auto-rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml (+ now Colors); the rest are manual.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: The type or namespace name 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Leftover Windows.UI.Colors reference the bootstrap did not rewrite.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler error WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly' + WMC9999
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade: the C# compile failed (the CS0234 above), so the project local assembly was never produced and the XAML compiler could not resolve the project's own type. NOT an x:DataType bug.
errors_encountered.fix: Fixing the CS0234 made the whole build (including XAML) succeed with no XAML edit (agent turns 27-29 -> BUILD_EXIT=0 at line 2933).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with 5 errors mixing CS0234 (Colors) and XamlCompiler WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Leftover Windows.UI.Colors namespace not auto-rewritten by the bootstrap; the C# failure cascaded into scary-looking XAML type-resolution errors.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent correctly diagnosed and fixed only the Colors namespace; the XAML errors cleared on their own.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap auto-rewriting Windows.UI.Colors; a validator residue flag for non-Xaml Windows.UI.* namespaces; a doc note that WMC0909/WMC1509 during MarkupCompilePass2 is usually a downstream C# compile failure.

env_issues.workaround: Meta-agent took behavioral ground truth from UWP source and confirmed against the WinUI capture-manifest outputText. This is an eval-side constraint, not a migration-skill issue.
